description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging with additional chaining capabilities. It includes methods for setting and getting the next LogNode, and a method to print log messages, optionally including exception details, and passing logs along a linked list chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility and implements the LogNode interface to enable chaining of log outputs.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority and tag, optionally including a Throwable, and passes the log to the next node in the chain if present.
